description: Generates lookalike domains of a brand (omission, transposition, repetition, bit-flip, homoglyph, vowel swap, hyphenation, TLD swap; technique list after dnstwist), checks up to 30 of them in DNS (A records), and reads MX records for up to 8 that resolve. Resolving in DNS is not proof of registration or abuse. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

domain.description: Brand domain, e.g. example.com (a host name with a dot, no scheme or path)

limit.description: Variants to look up in DNS, 1-40 (default 40)
